buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The EMD and all other required documents (compulsory for all bidders; no exemption for MSME/Star t-ups) uploaded at the time of bid participation shall also be physically submitted to the Buyer’s offi ce (EXECUTIVE OFFICER, NAGAR PANCHAYAT BARKHEDA PILIBHIT UTTAR PRADESH) within 5 days of the bid end date. 2. Mandatory Certificates: To be eligible for the award of the contract, the bidder must possess a va lid Labour Certificate/Registration for deployment of a minimum of 50 labour/workmen for Manpowe r Supply/Deployment Work in Uttar Pradesh, along with a valid Character Certificate and Self-Declar ation for Quality Manpower Services. The bidder shall upload these documents along with the bid. T he Labour Certificate/Registration must be issued by the competent authority and shall be valid as p er the applicable rules, regulations, and prescribed norms. 3. Bidders are required to submit PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, GST Certificate, and Cancelled Cheque alon g with the documents. 4. If any of the dates mentioned in the tender notice fall on a holiday, the tender will be opened on the next working day. 5. The bidder is required to upload a DM-verified Solvency Certificate for an amount of ₹20,00,000/- (R upees Twenty Lakh Only) along with the bid. 6. The service provider must have an Experience Certificate, and Gem Portal Order and Section order and it is mandatory to display it at the workplace. 7. If the work of the service provider is found satisfactory, the extension for the next term may be cons idered by the NAGAR PANCHAYAT BARKHEDA PILIBHIT UTTAR PRADESH / Administrator. 8. The documents submitted by the participating reseller company will be verified by the Buyer. If any document is found to be illegal, the bidder shall be blacklisted and/or legal action shall be initiated. I t is mandatory to upload a Declaration of Non-Blacklisting, No Criminal Record, and Not Being Regis tered with the Bar Council (State Government/Government of India) on a ₹100 notarized stamp pap er with proper attestation. The bidder further declares that he has a good reputation and conduct in NAGAR PANCHAYAT BARKHEDA PILIBHIT UTTAR PRADESH and in other departments. (Bid Eff ective Date) 9. The bidder is required to upload the following along with the bid: Character Certificate (For Contract or), EPFO Certificate and EPFO Return Slip, and ESIC Certificate. 10. To be eligible for award of contract, the bidder must upload Previous Month GST Return, Latest Turn over Certificate, Balance Sheet, and ITR Return.The Net Worth of the bidder must be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 12. To be eligible for award of contract, the bidder must upload Quality Management System Certificate and MSME Certificate with the bid. 13. The bidder shall upload a confirmation of acceptance of all bid conditions on their letterhead and m ust submit a hard copy of the same to the Buyer within 5 (five) days from the bid end date / bid ope ning date. 14. If the firm/company is a partnership, it is mandatory for all partners to upload their Aadhaar Card, P AN Card, and Partnership Deed and Character Certificate. 15. If the bidder is an Individual/Proprietorship, the Solvency Certificate must be issued in the name of t he bidder/proprietor. In case the bidder is a Firm, Company, or Partnership Firm, the Solvency Certifi cate must be issued in the name of the respective Firm/Company/Partnership Firm. Failing this, the bidder shall be disqualified and the bid shall be rejected. 16. Only bidders registered and operating within the State of Uttar Pradesh shall be eligible to participat e in this tender. Bids submitted by bidders registered outside the State of Uttar Pradesh shall be tre ated as non-responsive and shall be rejected during the technical evaluation stage, subject to applic able Government of Uttar Pradesh procurement rules and the conditions specified in the tender doc ument. 17. No bidder shall be eligible to participate in this tender if any of their close or blood relatives are em ployed as an officer or employee in the concerned department. 18. Queries or objections may be submitted only within the bid date and the prescribed time period. An y complaint received after the closure of the bid or at the time of bid opening shall not be considere d. 19. To be eligible for award of contract, bidder must possess following certificates uploaded with bid documen t Quality Management System Certificate and MSME registration. 20. In case the L1 bidder selected through the GeM portal fails to submit a valid similar work experience certifi cate in the concerned office within the stipulated period of 48 hours, the bid of the L1 bidder shall be disqu alified. 21. The bidder must possess a valid and active registration on the Uttar Pradesh Sewayojan (Employment) Por

tal. A copy of the registration certificate and/or the registration number shall be submitted along with the T echnical Bid. Failure to furnish a valid and active Sewayojan Portal registration shall render the bid liable t o be treated as non-responsive and rejected during the technical evaluation. 22. Queries or objections may be submitted only within the bid date and the prescribed time period. Any com plaint received after the closure of the bid or at the time of bid opening shall not be considered. 23. The undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all bids without assigning any reason. 24. CONDITION – ACCOUNT HOLDER BANK DETAILS: The bidder shall be required to upload the Acc ount Holder Bank Details along with the bid documents. The bank account must be in the name of th e bidder/firm. The bidder shall upload bank details clearly showing the Account Holder Name, Bank Name, Branch Name, Account Number, Account Type and IFSC Code, along with a Cancelled Chequ e or Bank Passbook/Bank Statement. Failure to upload the above-mentioned documents may result in rejection of the bidder’s technical bid. 25. Experience: The bidder must have successfully completed Manpower Supply/Deployment Wor k(s) during the last five financial years as follows: One Manpower Supply Work – value not less than 80% of the estimated cost of the bid; OR Two Manpower Supply Works – each having a value not less than 50% of the estimated cost of the bid; OR Three Manpower Supply Works – each having a value not less than 40% of the estimated cost of the bid. Only Manpower Supply/Deployment Work experience shall be considered. 26. BID CAPACITY: The bidder shall be qualified only if his/her Assessed Available Bid Capacity is equal to or more than the Estimated Cost / Total Bid Value of the work. The available Bid Capacity shall be calculated as per the following formula: Assessed Available Bid Capacity = (A × N × M) − B Where: A = Maximum value of Manpower Supply/Deployment Works successfully executed in any one year during the last five financial years, updated to the price level of the last year at the rate of 8% per a nnum, taking into account completed as well as ongoing works. N = Number of years prescribed for completion/execution of the Manpower Supply/Deployment Wor k for which the bid is invited. Completion period up to 6 months shall be taken as 0.5 year. Completion period of more than 6 months shall be taken as 1 year. M = 2.5 B = Value, at the current price level, of the bidder's existing Manpower Supply/Deployment commit ments and ongoing works to be completed during the period of execution of the work for which the bid is invited. Eligibility: The bidder shall be considered technically qualified under Bid Capacity only when: Assessed Available Bid Capacity ≥ Estimated Cost of the Work The bidder shall upload a Bid Capacity Certificate/Statement duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) along, showing the calculation of A, N, M and B. Details of all existing Manpower Supply/Deployment commitments and ongoing works shall also be submit ted in the prescribed format. Only Manpower Supply/Deployment Work experience shall be considered for calculation of Bid Capacity. Incorrect, incomplete, or unsupported Bid Capacity information may lead to rejection of the technical bid. Note: If the bidder does not upload any required document or uploads an unreadable/unclear scanned cop y, the bidder will be disqualified. .
